name: Yuke Yuke Aku no Monmusu Gundan! ~Kaijin Musume ni Shibori Torareru Ecchi de Kakoku na Sekai Seifuku Daisakusen~
original_name: ゆけゆけ悪のモンむす軍団！ ～怪人娘に搾り取られるえっちで過酷な世界性服大作戦～
source:
He, "Colonel Zero," was supposed to be the great evil mastermind!
With his command authority, he would issue orders to his cadre of monster subordinates, crush the forces of justice, and achieve world domination!

…Or so it was supposed to go.
But the so-called "heroes of justice" they faced were a ruthless bunch who would stop at nothing to win. Every time, his subordinates came back battered and bruised.

And so, these women turned to him…
Sometimes they lashed out in frustration, other times they genuinely sought comfort, teasing him or clinging to him in different ways—but always, they ended up demanding something intimate.

Colonel Zero, despite his timid and kind-hearted nature, had somehow ended up as a great evil mastermind.
His basic abilities weren’t particularly strong either, so he often found himself at their mercy.

And so, the mission of world domination began—or rather, the equally important task of providing mental support to his subordinates as they worked toward world conquest!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ011478.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
他，“零上校”，本应是伟大的邪恶幕后黑手！
凭借指挥权，他可以向怪物部下们发号施令，击溃正义势力，实现征服世界的野心！

……本来应该如此。

但他们面对的所谓“正义英雄”是一群不择手段求胜的狠角色。每一次，部下们都会遍体鳞伤地回来。

于是，这些女性转而向他寻求帮助……
有时她们因挫败发火，有时真心需要安慰，以不同方式逗弄他或黏着他——但最后总会要求某种亲密行为。

零上校性格胆小善良，却不知为何成了伟大的邪恶幕后黑手。基础能力也不算强，因此经常任人摆布。

就这样，征服世界的任务开始了——或者说，为了征服世界，给部下们提供精神支持这一同样重要的任务开始了！
